fusions.name: Hacked-Up Wad
fusions.desc: Hacks up a wad of swallowed fur and spits it at a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: End of the String
fusions.desc: Rakes a target up to 5 tiles away with a clawed strand, dealing 16 slashing damage that rises to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Tufted Pads
fusions.desc: Wraps your feet in fur and veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Whisker Warning
fusions.desc: Your whiskers give a second warning: once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
